mapper.select: select mn.*, se.*, se.Ex_Change_Status as exChangeStatus, c1.C_Name as cName, c1.C_Abbreviation as cAbbName, c1.C_Name_History as cNameHistory from Sec_Expert_Audit_Detail mn left join Sec_Expert_Audit ea on ea.id = mn.Sea_id left join Sec_Expert se on mn.Ex_Id = se.Ex_Id left join Sys_Company c1 on c1.C_Id = se.C_Id left join (select Ex_Id, year, count(*) as del_cnt from Sec_Expert_Delete where Ex_State = 7 group by Ex_Id, year) sedc on sedc.Ex_Id = se.Ex_Id and sedc.year = se.year left join (select Ex_Id, year, count(*) as chg_cnt from Sec_Expert_Change where Ex_State = 7 group by Ex_Id, year) secc on secc.Ex_Id = se.Ex_Id and secc.year = se.year left join (select Ex_Applicant_Id, count(*) as app_cnt from Sec_Expert where Ex_State != 3 group by Ex_Applicant_Id) seca on seca.Ex_Applicant_Id = se.Ex_Applicant_Id where se.year = #{year} and ea.State = 7 and se.Ex_State = 7
select ea.* from Sec_Expert_Audit_Detail mn left join Sec_Expert_Audit ea on ea.id = mn.Sea_id left join Sec_Expert se on mn.Ex_Id = se.Ex_Id where se.C_Id = #{cId} and ea.State = 7 limit 1
